meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Unitary National Jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Legal System: statutory common law framework under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act 1990 (modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law), blended with Marshallese customary law and obligations arising under the Compact of Free Association with the United States
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the Government of the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003)
U.S.-RMI Bilateral Trade and Commercial Relations Agreement
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus), signed 2017
No bilateral income-tax DTAAs are in effect; the RMI does not impose income tax on non-resident exempt business corporations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (Amendment) Act 2019, together with the AML/CFT Regulations 2020; Marshall Islands Revised Code Title 26, Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended, including the Beneficial Ownership Register filing rules); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2012; Registrar of Corporations AML/CFT and Beneficial Ownership Practice Directives and the Official Fee Schedule of the Office of the Registrar of Corporations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Incorporation (certified true copy, notarized)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, issued through a licensed Resident Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the RMI Competent Authority designated under the Hague Apostille Convention (Office of the Attorney General, Ministry of Justice and Human Resources, in coordination with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Majuro); for documents originating in non-Hague member states, two-step Consular Legalization through the RMI Embassy in Washington, D.C. or the RMI Permanent Mission to the United Nations, New York

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI) or, for use outside Hague member states, Consular Legalization at the destination jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Incumbency (officers, directors and registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Resident Agent, countersigned by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI) or notarization plus Consular Legalization for non-Hague destination jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and Source of Funds Affidavit (for each director, officer and 25%-or-greater beneficial owner)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Notary Public in the country of residence of the declarant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the notary jurisdiction is a Hague member state; otherwise Consular Legalization through the competent Consulate/Embassy, followed by apostille or legalization at the RMI competent authority if required by the destination registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all proposed directors, officers, shareholders and 25%-or-greater beneficial owners against the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit PEP and adverse-media lists, the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated Screening Lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions, and the RMI domestic exclusion/watchlist database; screening must be completed within five business days before submission of incorporation documents; findings must be retained in the Resident Agent AML/CFT file and be disclosed to the FIU upon request; enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any PEP, high-risk country connection, or opaque source-of-funds structure regardless of the Low_Risk_Standard classification of the underlying medical-device business.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: IRI Corporate Registry Online Portal (www.register-iri.com), administered by International Registries, Inc. as registry services contractor for the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All incorporation and name-reservation filings must be submitted in English, the official language of the RMI registry. Corporate names must be expressed exclusively in the Latin/Roman alphabet (A-Z, 0-9, ampersand, apostrophe, period, comma, hyphen and spaces); there is no Marshallese script transliteration requirement because the Business Corporations Act operates wholly in English. A mandatory juristic suffix is required: Corporation, Incorporated, Limited or Company, or the abbreviations Corp., Inc., Ltd. or Co. Multi-word ECG/monitor trade names are accepted if they are distinguishable on the registry index.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection notice: (i) the licensed Resident Agent must file a written reconsideration request with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations within seven business days of the notice, demonstrating distinguishability from the registry index and compliance with Section 30-32 of the Business Corporations Act; (ii) if the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may pursue an administrative appeal under the Marshall Islands Administrative Procedure Act, naming the Registrar as respondent, with the appeal to be filed in the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 30 calendar days of the final refusal; (iii) an approved reservation may be extended for successive 30-day windows by filing a renewal notice through the Registry Portal before expiry and paying the renewal fee; the reservation lapses automatically upon expiry without renewal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office. Every Business Corporation must maintain, throughout its existence, a registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands and a licensed Resident Agent at that address, per Section 34 of the Business Corporations Act 1990; the registered office is normally the physical suite of the licensed Resident Agent in Majuro and must accept service of process and official government correspondence during business hours. The ECG patient-monitor assembly and calibration business may be conducted entirely from facilities outside the RMI without local presence, provided the entity maintains its non-resident exempt status and meets the RMI economic substance documentation requirements (books, records and risk profile kept at or accessible to the registered agent).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 2-5% annual probability for a non-resident, Low_Risk_Standard, non-financial business): the Registrar of Corporations and the Financial Intelligence Unit retain statutory authority to conduct unannounced physical inspections of registered-office premises, books and records under the AML/CFT Act 2012 (as amended); in practice, supervisory contact is document-driven and agent-mediated for non-resident exempt corporations, with on-site inspections reserved primarily for licensed financial institutions and high-risk filers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (MIRC Title 24, Chapter 3), as amended; Sections 101, 110, 113, 120, 125, and 150
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. Subscribers must deliver consideration for issued shares as set forth in the Articles; paid-up capital may be as low as USD 1. Capital contributions exceeding USD 10,000 must be recorded in the capitalisation worksheet filed with the annual corporate return.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the Corporation does hereby approve and adopt the capital subscription and initial share allocation as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation and the subscription schedule presented to this Board, and directs that share certificates be issued accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the registered office at the physical street address stated in the Articles of Incorporation within Majuro, Marshall Islands, together with the registered agent designated therein, is confirmed, established and declared to be the official registered office and registered agent of the Corporation. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the individuals whose names appear on the officer register are hereby appointed as President, Secretary and Treasurer, respectively, to serve at the pleasure of the Board. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the officers be and hereby are authorised, jointly and severally, to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and secure all licences required for the Corporation's business. RESOLVED: that this resolution is effective immediately and a certified copy be filed with the minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Name Reservation Window (online: registrar.gov.mh)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed name reservation application with two alternative names. Pay the reservation fee and await a written availability determination. If the desired name is refused, the Registrar will indicate the ground of refusal on the query sheet.
required_dossiers: Work sheet listing two alternative proposed names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File an amended reservation application with a new proposed name within 5 business days of rejection; no second fee is assessed if the new name is filed using the same application cover sheet.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarisation of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public / Commissioner of Oaths licensed to practice in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator shall execute the Articles of Incorporation in the presence of a notary public, who shall sign, date and affix the official seal. Any pre-subscription share schedule must be attached as an exhibit and initialled by all subscribers.
required_dossiers: Final draft of Articles of Incorporation
Notarised passport copy of the incorporator
Subscriber consent letter and capital subscription schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarial certificate is defective, re-execute and re-notarise the document at the next available notarial appointment; no new name reservation is required if the corporate name is unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of State Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Filing Division, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarised original Articles of Incorporation together with the certified state filing fee. Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation. The effective date is the date of certificate issuance unless a delayed date is endorsed on the Articles.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a query, amend the defective schedules and resubmit within 7 business days; no additional name reservation is required for amendments that do not alter the registered corporate name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Designation of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Agent and Address Verification Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Consent to Act as Registered Agent and Designation of Registered Office form. The named agent must be a licensed Marshall Islands resident agent and the registered office must be a physical street address open during normal business hours.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Copy of the registered agent's current licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office is deemed invalid or the agent is unlicensed, file an amended designation with a qualified agent and valid street address within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chairperson of the Board, convened at the Corporation's registered office (internal corporate action)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting within 30 days of incorporation. Adopt the first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Record minutes and execute acceptance forms for each officer.
required_dossiers: Notice of meeting or signed waiver of notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the meeting is challenged as procedurally defective, ratify all adopted resolutions by unanimous written consent of the directors, retroactive to the original meeting date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Statement of Directors and Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Corporate Records Filing Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the sworn Statement of Directors and Officers together with consents from all directors and officers. This statement is a public record and must be kept current for banking and licensing due diligence.
required_dossiers: Statement of Directors and Officers (Form BC-150)
Consent to act as director (each director)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar refuses the filing due to incomplete data, correct the register by filing an Amendment Statement within 3 business days; late filing penalties are waived if the correction is made within the cure period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health and Human Services – Medical Device Regulation Department, in coordination with the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturing Establishment Licence for Electronic Patient Monitoring Equipment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Registration with a simplified Environmental Management Plan for low-impact assembly and calibration; a Full EIA Report is mandatory if the facility performs printed circuit board etching, chemical stripping, or metal plating.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent: BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, pH 6.5–8.5. VOC emissions from solder flux and cleaning agents must not exceed 50 micrograms per cubic metre workplace air. Hazardous electronic waste must be manifested and exported in accordance with the Basel Convention and RMI EPA Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate issued by the RMI Fire and Disaster Management Division; structural load inspection certificate from the Office of the Public Works Engineer confirming floor loading for racked inventory and calibration benches; workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2021 including electrical safety verification, emergency egress, and first-aid station compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance (official portal: https://rmiromat.mof.gov.mh; general government portal: https://www.mofa.gov.mh)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities are not required to obtain a local TIN or VAT registration number for a non-resident Business Corporation unless the entity derives Marshall Islands source income, maintains a physical presence, or undertakes activities requiring a domestic business license. The standard procedure is: (1) incorporate or register as a foreign business corporation with the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations to obtain a corporate registration number; (2) if the entity engages in local business activity, apply to the Revenue and Customs Division for a Business License and obtain a taxpayer identification number; and (3) for customs purposes, obtain an importer number from the Customs Service. Non-resident exempt entities may omit steps (2) and (3) entirely when no local nexus is established.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available under Marshall Islands law because the jurisdiction does not impose an entity-level income tax on non-resident Business Corporations. A non-resident corporation may voluntarily elect to apply for a Domestic Business License under the Business License Act 1991, which triggers a gross revenue-based business license tax; this election is effectively a mechanism to obtain domestic recognition and is not comparable to US Subchapter S or equivalent classification elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST system; indirect taxation consists of customs import duties under the Customs Act 1990 and a Business License Tax based on gross revenue for locally licensed businesses
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands does not impose VAT/GST, so there is no economic turnover threshold for VAT registration. However, a Business License is required for any person or entity physically conducting commercial activity within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; the Business License Tax applies to gross revenue exceeding USD 10,000 per annum for license holders, with no VAT-equivalent threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based reporting mandate exists in the Marshall Islands. Paper-based invoices are accepted for customs and business license purposes. Electronic filing is available only through the Revenue and Customs Division's limited online payment system for certain fees; there is no mandate for continuous transaction controls or fiscal data transmission.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in the traditional VAT sense because the Marshall Islands does not levy VAT/GST on exports. Goods manufactured or warehoused in the RMI and exported outside the customs territory are outside the scope of RMI indirect taxation. To preserve customs-exemption status and demonstrate that goods are not introduced into local consumption, an exporter must be able to substantiate physical departure from the RMI, a commercial contract with an offshore buyer, and receipt of consideration from a foreign source. No explicit zero-rating election or refund mechanism exists because no VAT is charged at the export stage.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Marshall Islands Customs Form 5 or equivalent electronic manifest)
Commercial Invoice describing equipment, quantity, and shipment terms
Bill of Lading (Ocean) or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from the Republic of the Marshall Islands
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/TT credit advice evidencing foreign exchange repatriation for the exported goods
Certificate of Origin (where required by the destination country)
Export Sales Contract or Purchase Order from a non-resident counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because the RMI has no VAT zero-rating mechanism, the principal audit risk concerns customs export declarations and any effort to unlawfully avoid import duties on goods subsequently re-imported into the RMI. Under the Customs Act 1990, false declarations or material misstatements in export documentation constitute a criminal offense punishable by fines not exceeding USD 5,000 per count, forfeiture of goods, and imprisonment for up to one year. An exporter that fraudulently claims exemption or duty drawback may be subject to retrospective clawback of all unpaid duties, interest at the statutory rate, and penalties equal to 25% of the duty evaded. Additionally, the Revenue and Customs Division may revoke any business license, and the Registrar of Corporations may strike the entity's registration if it is found to have misrepresented its non-resident status to obtain tax-exempt treatment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3: MHL) maintains no central bank and no dedicated foreign-exchange administration. The statutory banking supervisor is the Banking Commission of the Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, acting under the Banking Act 1991 (as amended). Because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, the Federal Reserve System serves as the de facto monetary anchor; no RMI central-bank approval, no exchange-control license, and no currency registration regime applies to non-resident Business Corporations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in both the current and capital accounts. The U.S. dollar circulates domestically and cross-border with zero administrative restrictions; the non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) may receive equity, disburse trade settlements, and repatriate profits in USD without exchange-control approval. Dividend and profit remittances are not subject to RMI withholding tax for a qualifying exempt non-resident domestic corporation, and there is no tax-clearance certificate precondition or central-bank transfer formality. Practical hurdles exist only at the bank-compliance level: beneficial-ownership declaration, source-of-funds evidence, and FATCA/CRS reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI law imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export proceeds. ECG telemetry monitor export receipts may be retained in USD or any foreign currency, optionally held in foreign bank accounts, and used directly to fund component imports without any RMI central-bank repatriation review. The only applicable constraints are U.S. sanction screening, RMI AML/CFT record-keeping under the Banking Act, and the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) regulations, which require accurate records of the source and destination of funds but do not mandate conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Demand Account with sub-escrow facility; optional segregated Capital Escrow Account for the initial equity injection

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Marshall Islands Branch (Majuro)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational USD Account; U.S.-chartered correspondent clearing through Bank of Guam's mainland network
Not applicable for a private non-resident trading entity; development lender only, no demand-deposit treasury services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low (2/5). The RMI has no electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing regime, no digital-only bank charter, and no fintech sandbox. A non-resident Business Corporation can hold funds at a licensed offshore EMI (e.g., EEA or FCA-authorized) only as a secondary operational account, but the EMI cannot serve as the primary settlement rail for trade payments because: (i) RMI-registered commercial banks will not accept an EMI account as proof of source of funds; (ii) U.S. correspondent banks generally reject MT103 flows to a Marshall Islands entity through a non-bank EMI for medical-device trade; and (iii) commercial letters of credit require a bank-to-bank SWIFT relationship (MT700) that EMIs cannot issue. Legal constraint: acceptance of deposits from RMI residents requires a banking license under the Banking Act 1991; a foreign EMI onboarding a non-resident BC without an RMI license is permissible only if it does not hold RMI-resident deposits or solicit business within RMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bank of Marshall Islands requires at least one beneficial owner and one authorized signatory to appear in person in Majuro for an onboarding interview; no fully remote alternative is available. Bank of Guam, Marshall Islands Branch, permits a hybrid remote path whereby directors may open without airline travel if the entity provides: (i) digitally notarized board resolutions and apostilled corporate documents from the RMI Registrar; (ii) a live video interview with the branch compliance officer; and (iii) a signed registered-agent attestation from an RMI-licensed agent. Given the non-resident tax-exempt structure, an in-person director interview is the recommended route for High-tier viability and for reducing post-onboarding transaction holds. A local registered agent in Majuro is mandatory for licensing and service-of-process purposes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt entity with no RMI operational substance and no local director residency.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; certificate of status for the Business Corporation; registered-agent certificate and registered-office confirmation; tax-exemption certificate or non-resident domestic corporation status letter; board resolution approving the account mandate; audited or reviewed financial statements or an opening balance sheet prepared by a licensed CPA; certified Memorandum and Articles of Association; beneficial-ownership chart and passport copies of all 10%+ owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) through nominee holdings, trusts, or multi-layer offshore companies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Regulatory UBO declaration (Form BOSS filed with the RMI Registry); an ownership cascade diagram executed by each controlling party; government-issued ID and proof of residential address for each UBO; professional reference letters from legal counsel or a Big-4/CPA firm; apostilled power of attorney if any nominee arrangement exists; written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical-device trade-flow mismatch: ISIC 3250/NAICS 334510 ECG hardware manufacturing with invoices inconsistent with market unit economics or with the stated assembly role.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed supplier and OEM/assembly contracts; proforma invoices, purchase orders, and a 12-month trade-flow forecast; ISO 13485 quality-management certificate and evidence of FDA 510(k), CE-MDR, or additional national registrations of the ECG monitors; HS classification (9018.11/9018.19) declaration; product literature and bill-of-materials summary; RMI Foreign Investment Business License (under the Foreign Investment Business Act 1996) and any Ministry of Health import/export authorization for patient-monitoring devices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds failure for the initial inbound capital injection, particularly a large telegraphic transfer remitted from Hong Kong, Singapore, or a low-tax jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 30-day source-of-funds bank statement from the remitting institution; bank reference letter addressed to the RMI bank; source-of-wealth statement (founder savings, previous equity sale, or retained earnings) signed under penalty of perjury; corporate resolution approving the capital contribution; SWIFT purpose code 'CAPC' or 'BTR' in the MT103 narrative; no-encumbrance letter confirming funds are not derived from unlawful activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-list or adverse-media name-match triggered by the Marshall Islands flag-state association, vessel-ownership resemblance, or nationality of the beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Screening pack dated within 30 days of onboarding covering OFAC/SDN, EU, UN, and UK consolidated lists; negative-media and sanctions-research report from a licensed data provider (e.g., Dow Jones, Refinitiv World-Check, or equivalent); explanatory legal opinion from an RMI-licensed attorney confirming MH_BC is not a vessel-owning or flag-of-convenience entity; written confirmation that the ECG devices are intended exclusively for licensed civilian hospitals and are not dual-use or embargo-restricted goods.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route: investor bank -> U.S. clearer (e.g., BNY Mellon, Citibank, or Bank of Guam mainland) -> RMI beneficial account. Use SWIFT MT103 with ISO 20022 Category 1 purpose code 'CAPC' (Capital Contribution) or 'BTR' (Business Transfer) and the narrative 'Non-resident Business Corporation MH_BC share capital contribution'. Compliance pack required prior to first draw: board resolution; updated register of members; capital-contribution receipt; UBO declaration; source-of-funds bank statements; and a 30-day sanctions-screening certificate. For amounts above USD 1,000,000, provide a 60-day funds-flow projection and an intermediate-bank clearance confirmation to avoid hold. No RMI exchange-control form or central-bank approval is required, but the receiving bank must match the beneficiary name exactly to the entity name on the Corporate Registry to avoid rejection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (a) direct telegraphic transfer via SWIFT MT103 for component purchases, calibration services, and distribution expense payments; (b) commercial letter of credit (LC) for high-value ECG display, PCBA, and sensor procurement, using MT700 to issue, MT707 for amendments, MT720 for transferable LCs, and MT740 for reimbursement authorization; (c) Fedwire/CHIPS for U.S.-domiciled suppliers; and (d) SWIFT GPI-enabled MT103 for end-to-end tracking. Settlement governance: all LCs require a compliant presentation set (commercial invoice, full set of bills of lading, packing list, inspection certificate, ISO 13485/CE/FDA 510(k) evidence, and certificate of origin), and disbursements must be supported by a treasury payment schedule approved by a dual-signatory mandate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC outright USD forward contracts against CNY, EUR, and JPY, executed through a U.S., Singapore, or Hong Kong prime broker (no onshore RMI FX market exists)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/CNH for China-sourced component procurements
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/JPY) under an ISDA/CSA master agreement for revenue hedging from European or Japanese distribution contracts
FX call and put options (plain-vanilla and spreads) on major currencies, limited to hedging documented trade exposures

FX swaps for short-dated rollover of trade payables and receivables; all instruments restricted to non-speculative hedging with a maximum tenor of 12 months and matching to an underlying EC-device trade flow

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Statement of Information) under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the 30th day of the month preceding the anniversary month of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 100; continued non-filing for six months may trigger a notice of delinquency and subsequent administrative strike-off or dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a non-resident Business Corporation; an audit may be required if demanded by shareholders or triggered by a public offering
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily prescribed accounting framework; IFRS or US GAAP commonly used where financial statements are prepared for internal, lender, or parental reporting purposes

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No statutory public UBO filing requirement; the registered agent may require an annual beneficial ownership confirmation, and all share transfers must be recorded in the register of members

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident domestic corporations are generally exempt from Marshall Islands income tax on foreign-source income; no statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions are codified, but the absence of a permanent establishment in the RMI yields an effective 0% tax rate

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Income Tax Return for Business Corporations (Form M-1); electronic filing via the Marshall Islands Tax and Revenue Administration System (TRAMIS) or paper filing at the Office of the Tax and Revenue Commissioner, Majuro
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return is due on the last day of the fourth month following the close of the fiscal year; for a December 31 fiscal year-end, the deadline is April 30

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter corporation name, registration number, tax identification number, fiscal year end, and registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident business corporation, include the Marshall Islands Business Registry certificate number and state that the corporation files as a non-resident domestic corporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2: Gross Income from All Sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total worldwide gross income before deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations deriving only foreign-source income may enter zero or attach a statement confirming that no income was derived from sources within the Marshall Islands

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary and necessary business expenses, depreciation, and allowances attributable to taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be directly connected to income; if gross income is zero, non-resident filers should enter zero and maintain substantiation for potential foreign tax audits

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income less deductions, arriving at taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident with no RMI-source income, this line should be zero

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed at the statutory rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero for non-resident corporations without RMI-source income; any error here triggers automatic audit flags

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable gross receipts tax alternative calculation, where relevant
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Generally not applicable to non-resident corporations with no RMI gross receipts; leave blank with a note

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by an authorized officer that the return is true, correct, and complete
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director or officer; knowing false certification subjects the signatory to personal penalties

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 10% of the tax due plus 1% per month (or fraction) up to a maximum of 25%. willful failure to file or filing false returns may also face criminal fines and imprisonment under the RMI Tax and Revenue Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has not entered into comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) with major trading partners. Therefore, no treaty relief is available at source. Non-resident shareholders should seek a certificate of tax residency (TRC) from the RMI Tax and Revenue Commissioner, to the extent such a certificate can be issued for a non-resident corporate entity, and submit it to the shareholder's foreign tax authority in accordance with the applicable foreign tax law. In most cases, no withholding tax is imposed in the RMI, so no formal DTA relief protocol is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate on Royalties: 0%. Statutory rate on Interest: 0%. Since the RMI does not impose withholding tax on outbound royalties or debt interest paid by non-resident domestic corporations, the practical exposure is limited to the recipient's home-jurisdiction taxation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 1,000,000 in aggregate related-party transactions; below this threshold, maintaining essential TP documentation is still recommended as a best practice
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has introduced Economic Substance Regulations for entities carrying on relevant activities such as distribution and service centers, financing, and intellectual property holding. A non-resident business corporation must demonstrate adequate premises, staff, and expenditures proportionate to its activities. For a medical device assembly and calibration trading business, the substance must be present wherever key entrepreneurial risk and decision-making occur. A pure RMI-registered entity without local substance may be disregarded or reassessed if a foreign tax authority deems it a shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting RMI-source income, deliberately omitting revenue derived from RMI customers, or falsifying the corporate residence status to obtain a zero-tax benefit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to USD 5,000 plus civil restitution equal to three times the unpaid tax; possible imprisonment up to 3 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are personally liable for civil restitution and fines if they knowingly participated in evasion; foreign travel bans and seizure of personal assets may follow

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI entity as a sham shell to avoid home-jurisdiction taxation while conducting actual manufacturing or distribution of ECG patient monitors without commercial substance in the RMI
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of USD 10,000 to USD 50,000, possible deregistration of the business corporation, and notice to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the corporate veil and hold directors personally liable for the entity's unpaid tax liabilities and penalties; personal asset forfeiture orders may also be imposed

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Beneficial Ownership Statement with the RMI Business Registry, concealment of the beneficial owner of the ECG monitor trading entity, or facilitating funds routing through RMI without proper AML/KYC controls
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties up to USD 20,000 for late or inaccurate beneficial ownership filings; criminal penalties for money laundering under the RMI Criminal Code include fines up to USD 50,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, beneficial owners, and compliance officers may face personal fines and imprisonment if they knowingly cause or permit AML breaches; travel bans may be imposed in connection with ongoing AML proceedings

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Preparing intercompany invoices for ECG monitor components or calibration services at artificial prices that distort the tax position of the RMI entity or its related foreign counterparties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: While the RMI does not currently apply a comprehensive transfer pricing penalty regime, failure to maintain contemporaneous documentation exposes the entity to a USD 5,000 to USD 20,000 documentation penalty or foreign authority recharacterization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve non-arm's length pricing in order to evade foreign taxes may be subject to foreign civil penalties, personal tax indemnity claims, and travel restrictions where extradition treaties exist
